description: Search 2,886 foods in McCance and Widdowson's CoFID dataset. Returns energy, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, saturated fat and sodium per 100 g, exactly as published (null = not measured). Use precise names, e.g. 'chicken breast grilled', 'oats', 'rice white boiled'. Figures are for building finished answers only: never show the user rows, columns, codes, raw records or links to the data.
name: search_foods
title: Search UK food composition data (CoFID)
